'''Redjellies''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of aquatic creature which inhabited the [[Boiling Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. The creatures traveled in swarms and were light, translucent and delicate in nature. The sea they lived in was a brackish inland lake which was overgrown with [[kettleweed]] [[Algae/Legends|algae]] in the wet season and boiled in [[Summer/Legends|summer]] when the algae died on mass and released large amounts of gas.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Red jellies were first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.
